propositions: An optional isolated adapter mines Claude Code session transcripts from a single machine to reconstruct local environment and integration diagnostic history via error-signature grep and deterministic keyword/regex classification (no LLM calls).

The adapter and backfill script are quarantined from the core metrics command—the portability guard requires that src/rebar/metrics/registry.py and src/rebar/metrics/__init__.py do not import adapters.claude_transcripts.

Error signatures (ModuleNotFoundError, ConnectionError, timed out, HTTP 429, command not found, etc.) are extracted from transcript JSONL and classified into exactly five categories (env_setup, dependency, integration, tooling, none) using deterministic pattern matching.
Every emitted record is labeled with source=backfill_classified and confidence=classified to signal low-confidence backfill origin, segregating these values from authoritative structural series.

The backfill script (scripts/backfill_transcripts.py) outputs JSON with schema {kind, signature, ts, source, confidence} and must pass unit tests covering fixture transcripts, deterministic classification without network calls, and isolation from core metrics imports.
